tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures support the coupled siphon-memory ODE, but the five endpoint observations do not adequately separate its five parameters. The trajectory batch adds time-resolved constraints and brings the fit to at least eight rows before fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon endpoints for five parameters leave no residual degrees of freedom, and the coupling strength and fast memory time constant can trade off over this horizon range.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a snapshot-only creep or oscillator model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Neither model accounts for both the observed sink-gradient dependence and the coupled transient lag.
It is not on the menu, and the pilot gradients already span 1.95 without detected collinearity.
It does not constrain the coupled memory dynamics.
